rule: every variant of the clap `enum Commands` in cli/tri/src/main.rs, kebab-case as clap derives it

commands.name: kinds
commands.help: Match arms whose own comment names a case the pattern omits.

commands.name: lean
commands.help: Completeness theorems whose Lean model is empty.

commands.name: fpga
commands.help: FPGA programming via the in-tree DLC10 driver (pure Rust).

commands.name: mutate
commands.help: Find the constants in a checker that nothing actually checks.

commands.name: reseal
commands.help: Recompute the FROZEN_HASH seal from the file it seals.

commands.name: now
commands.help: Write a docs/now/ entry without hand-writing the frame.

commands.name: ci
commands.help: Is the hardware this plan assumes actually attached? CI questions about the repository's own gates.

commands.name: pr
commands.help: Is this pull request actually safe to merge?

commands.name: merging
commands.help: Is a merge in flight here, and does this branch carry the base?

commands.name: misread
commands.help: The specs the compiler reads WRONGLY. Every gate is green on them.

commands.name: one-away
commands.help: Failing specs one defect from compiling, and what that defect is

commands.name: window
commands.help: Was the base you measured against still the tip when you reported?

commands.name: worktrees
commands.help: What the checkouts on this disk are holding. Deletes nothing.

commands.name: sweep
commands.help: Synthesise across a parameter and check the area actually moves.

commands.name: synth
commands.help: Synthesise a top module and report area, with the instrument named.

commands.name: loop
commands.help: What is failing on the default branch right now, and since when. Take a named claim so two sessions of the loop cannot pick the same task.

commands.name: gates
commands.help: Find workflows that have never once succeeded.

commands.name: harness
commands.help: Source files no crate root reaches, and so nothing compiles. Test-harness hygiene.

commands.name: elab
commands.help: Classify a compiler's error output before quoting a number from it.

commands.name: rtl
commands.help: The structural check t27.ai offers, run locally: five verdicts, the yosys version beside the numbers, and no claim about correctness.

commands.name: abandoned
commands.help: Recovery sites whose own comment names the construct they discard.

commands.name: fmt
commands.help: Type names with more than one definition in the spec tree. Run the formatter and restore every file it rewrote that you had not touched.

commands.name: topic
commands.help: Has anyone already done this, or are they doing it now?

commands.name: quantifiers
commands.help: Every quantified clause, its binders, and the size of its domain.

commands.name: orphaned
commands.help: Checks whose input is not in the tree.

commands.name: discard
commands.help: What the parser reads and throws away, ranked against its pinned bound.

commands.name: prose
commands.help: Specs a literate author left prose in, and how far that prose is from code.

commands.name: ledgers
commands.help: Does each ledger's gate notice when one of its entries stops being true?

commands.name: census
commands.help: Specs the compiler cannot read, ranked by the construct that stops it. Every census's printed population, against one counted another way.

commands.name: competitors
commands.help: The competitor table against its own contract: how many of its published scores were never published, and how many papers it counts twice.

commands.name: issues
commands.help: Open issues whose headline calls a workflow red, against what that workflow concludes on master today.

commands.name: emit
commands.help: Does the same binary produce the same generated code twice?

commands.name: jumps
commands.help: What happened to every `break` and `continue` the Verilog emitter had to lower?

commands.name: vsim
commands.help: How far each spec gets when its generated Verilog is actually RUN.

commands.name: seals
commands.help: What `.trinity/seals` says about a spec, when it says it twice.

commands.name: hooks
commands.help: Pure-Rust ports of repository commit / push gates.

commands.name: vectors
commands.help: The executed-vector registry: run a module's vectors, or inventory which files are executed and which are only displayed.
